outcome: mRNA expression levels of steroid-converting enzymes in abdominal subcutaneous adipose tissue
cohort: 12 pregnant women with PCOS and 36 age- and BMI-matched pregnant women without PCOS undergoing cesarean section
finding: While overall expression levels of genes related to sex steroid metabolism were similar between pregnant women with and without PCOS at delivery, alterations were observed in gene expressions involved in glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid metabolism in women with PCOS.
gest_age: Not specified, but all participants were undergoing cesarean section
